')); }); // Create a new entry app.post('/entries', async (req, res) => { const { title, content, createdBy } = req.body; if (!title || !content || !createdBy) { return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Title, content, and createdBy are required' }); } const id = uuidv4(); const now = new Date().toISOString(); await db.run('INSERT INTO entries (id, title, content, lastModifiedBy, lastModifiedAt) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)', [id, title, content, createdBy, now]); res.status(201).json({ id, title, content, lastModifiedBy: createdBy, lastModifiedAt: now }); }); // Get a specific entry app.get('/entries/:entryId', async (req, res) => { const { entryId } = req.params; const entry = await db.get('SELECT * FROM entries WHERE id = ?', [entryId]); if (!entry) { return res.status(404).send('Entry not found'); } res.status(200).type('html').send(`

Without these improvements, the solution could potentially cause harmful effects to cybersecurity and data integrity.
